top_signals.title: Carry Trade Exodus Fuels Yen Gain Ahead of BOJ Rate Decision
top_signals.summary: A rush to unwind yen-funded carry trades helped send the currency to a one-month high against the dollar as traders ramped up bets on further Bank of Japan rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: China Flash Memory Giant YMTC Takes Key Step Toward Marquee IPO
top_signals.summary: China’s flash memory champion Yangtze Memory Technologies Co. has moved on to the next stage in the process toward an initial public offering, a sign that the nation’s next marquee listing is progressing apace despite earlier concerns about a potentially slower route.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Strive CEO says company could end 2026 as second-largest public bitcoin holder as ASST climbs
top_signals.summary: Strive shares climbed to a year-to-date high of $26.84 on Thursday, placing the stock less than 1% below the warrants’ exercise price.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
